note: v615: .thunder() on the stage. When a typed strike (tobi.thunder(), una, the scene, an object or a place) lands on the box, the stage flashes white and rumbles once, in under a second, CSS only; the layer exists only during the strike, so nothing runs between strikes. Cool mode and reduced motion get one static dim frame, and a hidden tab plays nothing. The struck figure's cut shakes once. Refusals (a second strike within 3 jobs, an unknown subject) play nothing.
